motifs.name: tall_right_willow_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the tall leafy tree on the right with its pale upright trunk, forked upper branching, and cascading dark ink foliage clusters. Include the upper crown, side branch extending toward the right edge, lower hanging leaves, and the full visible trunk down to the root area, but exclude calligraphy, seals, and unrelated rocks beyond the immediate root contact.
must_preserve: soft gray trunk wash with darker contour lines
forked trunk geometry and subtle bark streaks
repeated hooked leaf strokes in dense clusters
lighter misty gaps between foliage masses
right-edge branch tips and drooping leaves

motifs.name: leaning_gnarled_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the central leaning gnarled tree crossing diagonally upward from lower right toward left, including its twisted trunk, bare twiggy branches, and dark leaf clusters attached around the trunk. Keep it separate from the taller right tree as much as possible.
must_preserve: diagonal S-curved trunk with pale wash highlight
dry-brush bark texture and dark contour accents
fine bare branch linework at the top and sides
dense dark leaf dabs hugging the trunk
overlapping but distinct twig silhouettes

motifs.name: seated_scholar_on_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the small seated scholar figure on the low bank near the water. Include the robe outline, head and facial indication, folded posture, and the thin ground line or mat directly supporting the figure, but not the surrounding trees or large water area.
must_preserve: delicate pale ink facial and hair outline
folded seated robe geometry
fine contour lines of sleeves and knees
small dark accents defining posture
subtle ground/mat line beneath the figure

motifs.name: quiet_water_shoals
motifs.description: Isolate the calm water and low shoal forms across the lower middle-left, including horizontal wash bands, soft shoreline edges, and small dotted vegetation along the banks. Exclude the seated scholar as a separate motif where possible.
must_preserve: horizontal ink wash bands suggesting still water
soft blurred shore and sandbar edges
small dark vegetation dots along the banks
faint layered tonal gradations
open negative space between the shoals

motifs.name: right_foreground_rocky_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the sloping rocky bank in the lower right beneath the trees, including the diagonal rock planes, dotted moss shrubs, root contact, and dry-brush texture. Avoid the red seals at the lower right and bottom.
must_preserve: diagonal rock striations in gray wash
dark moss-dot clusters along ridge edges
irregular shrub silhouettes at the top of the slope
root-like dark lines near the tree base
soft transitions between rock planes

motifs.name: lower_left_rock_shrub_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground rocks and shrub bank at the lower left, including rounded boulders, dark stippled foliage, and small shoreline protrusions. Exclude any red seal impressions near the extreme bottom edge.
must_preserve: rounded rock forms with pale interior wash
dark stippled shrub texture
broken dry-brush outlines on stone edges
small protruding stones near the water
